name: hfpapers
description: Hugging Face Papers (huggingface.co/papers): search AI research papers by topic, browse daily, weekly, monthly and trending paper lists, and get paper details (authors, abstract, AI summary, GitHub and project links, linked models and spaces) or the full text as markdown.

commands.name: search-papers
commands.summary: Search Hugging Face papers by topic or keywords; returns title, authors, abstract, AI summary, keywords, GitHub repo, upvotes and publish date.

params.name: q
params.description: Topic or keywords to search for, e.g. 'diffusion language models'

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of results to return (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.sample: {"paper.id":"2105.14039","paper.title":"Towards mental time travel: a hierarchical memory for reinforcement\n  learning agents","paper.authors.name":["Andrew Kyle Lampinen","Stephanie C. commands.name: list-daily-papers
commands.summary: List curated Daily Papers. Use date for one day, week for a week or month for a month; sort=trending ranks by trend. Pages with p.

params.name: date
params.description: Day to list, ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-10-20. Omit for the latest papers.

params.name: week
params.description: ISO week to list, YYYY-Www, e.g. 2026-W43

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order. Use 'trending' to rank by trend. Omit for the default order.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: p
params.description: Page number (0-based; 1 is the second page)

commands.name: list-papers
commands.summary: List recent papers from the papers index, optionally filtered by a keyword query; returns id, title, authors, abstract, upvotes and publish date.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Maximum number of papers to return (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

commands.name: get-paper
commands.summary: Get one paper by arXiv id: title, authors, abstract, AI summary and keywords, project page, GitHub repo and stars, organization, and linked models, datasets and spaces.

params.name: paperId
params.description: arXiv id of the paper, e.g. 2511.03276

commands.name: get-paper-markdown
commands.summary: Get the full text of a paper as markdown (title, authors, abstract, body), by arXiv id.

params.name: paperId
params.description: arXiv id of the paper, e.g. 2512.22234

commands.name: list-trending-papers
commands.summary: List currently trending papers with title, short summary, organization, publish date, upvotes, and GitHub and arXiv links.
commands.sample: {"title":"Harness^2: Recursive Agent Harnessing for an Open World","url":"https://huggingface.co/papers/2610.14224","summary":"Harness² improves agent execution harnesses through recursive task-level refinement and continual harness-level learning, boosting performance across benchmarks without ground-truth verifiers.","organization":"Google","upvotes":"115"

notes: Papers are identified by arXiv id (e.g. 2512.22234). Page: https://huggingface.co/papers/<id>; arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/<id>; PDF: https://arxiv.org/pdf/<id>.

To find papers by topic, use search-papers. For recent curated papers, use list-daily-papers (date/week/month). For the abstract and links of one paper, use get-paper; for its full text, use get-paper-markdown.
